title: A coherent module supported in the zero set of an ideal is killed by a power of it
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] with quasi-compact underlying space), $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent] and $\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals, with $\mathcal K^t\mathcal F$ as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0); let $V(\mathcal K)=\{x\in X:\mathcal K_x\ne\mathcal O_{X,x}\}$ (the closed subset underlying the closed subscheme cut out by $\mathcal K$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]; on an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}A$ it is $V(\mathcal K(\operatorname{Spec}A))$). Then $\mathcal K^t\mathcal F=0$ for some $t\ge0$ if and only if $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)\subseteq V(\mathcal K)$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base] (2).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01Y9 (lemma-power-ideal-kills-sheaf, line 2569); its proof: a finite covering by spectra of Noetherian rings and Algebra, Lemma 00L6 (algebra-lemma-Noetherian-power-ideal-kills-module, algebra.tex line 14997)
